# Contact the patriots of STATE_GUIZHOU: claim the region at a cost of 25 call progress.
nesnd_uni_contact_STATE_GUIZHOU = {
	name = nesnd_uni_contact_STATE_GUIZHOU
	desc = nesnd_uni_contact_STATE_GUIZHOU_desc
	visible = {
		NOT = { has_global_variable = nesnd_uni_declared }
		OR = {
			s:STATE_GUIZHOU = {
				any_neighbouring_state = {
					owner = root
				}
			}
			s:STATE_GUIZHOU = {
				any_scope_state = {
					owner = root
				}
			}
		}
		NOT = { country_or_subject_owns_entire_state_region = STATE_GUIZHOU }
		NOT = { has_claim = s:STATE_GUIZHOU }
	}
	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = nesnd_uni_call_25_tt
			je:nesnd_uni_country ?= {
				scripted_bar_progress = {
					name = nesnd_uni_call_bar
					value >= 25
				}
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		s:STATE_GUIZHOU = { add_claim = root }
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = nesnd_uni_call_minus_25_tt
			je:nesnd_uni_country ?= {
				add_progress = {
					name = nesnd_uni_call_bar
					value = -25
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				s:STATE_GUIZHOU = {
					any_scope_state = {
						NOT = { owner = root }
						average_sol < 8
					}
				}
			}
			s:STATE_GUIZHOU = {
				every_scope_state = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { owner = root }
						average_sol < 8
					}
					add_radicals_in_state = {
						value = 0.05
						strata = lower
					}
					add_radicals_in_state = {
						value = 0.15
						strata = upper
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			custom_tooltip = nesnd_uni_contact_calm_tt
		}
	}
	ai_chance = {
		base = 0
		modifier = {
			trigger = {
				je:nesnd_uni_country ?= {
					scripted_bar_progress = {
						name = nesnd_uni_call_bar
						value >= 25
					}
				}
			}
			add = 10
		}
		modifier = {
			trigger = {
				je:nesnd_uni_country ?= {
					scripted_bar_progress = {
						name = nesnd_uni_call_bar
						value >= 60
					}
				}
			}
			add = 20

	visible = {
		NOT = { has_global_variable = nesnd_uni_declared }
		OR = {
			s:STATE_HAINAN = {
				any_neighbouring_state = {
					owner = root
				}
			}
			s:STATE_HAINAN = {
				any_scope_state = {
					owner = root
				}
			}
		}
		NOT = { country_or_subject_owns_entire_state_region = STATE_HAINAN }
		NOT = { has_claim = s:STATE_HAINAN }
	}
	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = nesnd_uni_call_25_tt
			je:nesnd_uni_country ?= {
				scripted_bar_progress = {
					name = nesnd_uni_call_bar
					value >= 25
				}
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		s:STATE_HAINAN = { add_claim = root }
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = nesnd_uni_call_minus_25_tt
			je:nesnd_uni_country ?= {
				add_progress = {
					name = nesnd_uni_call_bar
					value = -25
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				s:STATE_HAINAN = {
					any_scope_state = {
						NOT = { owner = root }
						average_sol < 8
					}
				}
			}
			s:STATE_HAINAN = {
				every_scope_state = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { owner = root }
						average_sol < 8
					}
					add_radicals_in_state = {
						value = 0.05
						strata = lower
					}
					add_radicals_in_state = {
						value = 0.15
						strata = upper
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			custom_tooltip = nesnd_uni_contact_calm_tt
		}
	}
	ai_chance = {
		base = 0
		modifier = {
			trigger = {
				je:nesnd_uni_country ?= {
					scripted_bar_progress = {
						name = nesnd_uni_call_bar
						value >= 25
					}
				}
			}
			add = 10
		}
		modifier = {
			trigger = {
				je:nesnd_uni_country ?= {
					scripted_bar_progress = {
						name = nesnd_uni_call_bar
						value >= 60
					}
				}
			}
			add = 20
		}
	}
}

# Contact the patriots of STATE_OUTER_MANCHURIA: claim the region at a cost of 25 call progress.
nesnd_uni_contact_STATE_OUTER_MANCHURIA = {
	name = nesnd_uni_contact_STATE_OUTER_MANCHURIA
	desc = nesnd_uni_contact_STATE_OUTER_MANCHURIA_desc
	visible = {
		NOT = { has_global_variable = nesnd_uni_declared }
		OR = {
			s:STATE_OUTER_MANCHURIA = {
				any_neighbouring_state = {
					owner = root
				}
			}
			s:STATE_OUTER_MANCHURIA = {
				any_scope_state = {
					owner = root
				}
			}
		}
		NOT = { country_or_subject_owns_entire_state_region = STATE_OUTER_MANCHURIA }
		NOT = { has_claim = s:STATE_OUTER_MANCHURIA }
	}
	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = nesnd_uni_call_25_tt
			je:nesnd_uni_country ?= {
				scripted_bar_progress = {
					name = nesnd_uni_call_bar
					value >= 25
				}
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		s:STATE_OUTER_MANCHURIA = { add_claim = root }
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = nesnd_uni_call_minus_25_tt
			je:nesnd_uni_country ?= {
				add_progress = {
					name = nesnd_uni_call_bar
					value = -25
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				s:STATE_OUTER_MANCHURIA = {
					any_scope_state = {
						NOT = { owner = root }
						average_sol < 8
					}
				}
			}
			s:STATE_OUTER_MANCHURIA = {
				every_scope_state = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { owner = root }
						average_sol < 8
					}
					add_radicals_in_state = {
						value = 0.05
						strata = lower
					}
					add_radicals_in_state = {
						value = 0.15
						strata = upper
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			custom_tooltip = nesnd_uni_contact_calm_tt
		}
	}
	ai_chance = {
		base = 0
		modifier = {
			trigger = {
				je:nesnd_uni_country ?= {
					scripted_bar_progress = {
						name = nesnd_uni_call_bar
						value >= 25
					}
				}
			}
			add = 10
		}
		modifier = {
			trigger = {
				je:nesnd_uni_country ?= {
					scripted_bar_progress = {
						name = nesnd_uni_call_bar
						value >= 60
					}
				}
			}
			add = 20
		}
	}

					owner = root
				}
			}
			s:STATE_TOKAI = {
				any_scope_state = {
					owner = root
				}
			}
		}
		NOT = { country_or_subject_owns_entire_state_region = STATE_TOKAI }
		NOT = { has_claim = s:STATE_TOKAI }

					name = nesnd_uni_call_bar

		}

	effect = {

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = nesnd_uni_call_minus_25_tt
			je:nesnd_uni_country ?= {
				add_progress = {
					name = nesnd_uni_call_bar
					value = -25
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				s:STATE_TOKAI = {
					any_scope_state = {
						NOT = { owner = root }
						average_sol < 8
					}
				}
			}
			s:STATE_TOKAI = {
				every_scope_state = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { owner = root }
						average_sol < 8
					}
					add_radicals_in_state = {
						value = 0.05
						strata = lower
					}
					add_radicals_in_state = {
						value = 0.15
						strata = upper
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			custom_tooltip = nesnd_uni_contact_calm_tt
		}
	}
	ai_chance = {
